content_fixes.old: Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born because they saw he was a special kid and weren't scared of the king's temple guards. When Moses grew up, he refused to be called a prince of Egypt. He chose to suffer with God's people rather than live a cushy life of sin. He knew that sticking with the Messiah was worth more than all the treasure in Egypt. He wasn't scared of the king's rage because he kept his eyes on the God no one can see.
